Part 1: The Wagon Road

This short adventure is original synthetic text written for Kit. It is not from any published book.

Road Ambush
> Dust hangs over a dry wagon road. A broken wheel blocks the ruts.
Two bandits crouch in the ditch. They attack anyone who steps off the road.
A dry path runs on to the hideout, area 1.

1. Timber Mouth
> A timbered mouth opens in a sandy bank.
A ladder drops to area 2.

2. Store Niche
> Crates are stacked against the wall.
The ladder climbs back to area 1.
